thread.title: Apple Likely To Refresh iPad Pro, Mac Lineup At Oct. 30 Event | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Likely To Refresh iPad Pro, Mac Lineup At Oct. 30 Event | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Consumer electronics giant Apple ( AAPL ) on Thursday announced that it will hold a product launch event on Oct. 30 in New York City. Analysts expect the company to debut its latest iPad Pro tablets and Mac computers at the event.
X The media event is being held at the Brooklyn Academy of Music, CNBC reported . It comes more than a month after Apple unveiled its 12th-generation iPhone lineup and fourth-generation Apple Watch at a Sept. 12 event at its headquarters in Cupertino, Calif.
Apple Rumors The company's new iPad Pro tablets are rumored to mimic design features of the latest iPhones. The tablets will have no physical home button and will use a FaceID facial recognition camera to unlock the device instead of a fingerprint reader. The tablets also will have narrower bezels for more display space, analysts say. A new Apple Pencil stylus is also on tap, they say.
Apple's new Mac computers are said to include a Mac Mini Pro and a lower-cost MacBook with Retina display. The company's iMac desktop computers also are overdue for a refresh.

Busy Season For Consumer Electronics Launches It's been a busy season for major tech companies holding consumer electronics launch events. Apple got the ball rolling with its iPhone XS event last month.
On Sept. 20 , Amazon.com ( AMZN ) announced a flurry of smart home devices at an event at its corporate headquarters in Seattle. It unveiled an expanded lineup of Echo smart speakers and other devices controlled with voice assistant Alexa. The new Alexa-enabled gadgets include a microwave oven, wall clock and smart electric plug. Amazon also introduced Fire TV Recast , a TV set-top box that can record and replay free, over-the-air television broadcasts.
On Oct. 2 , Microsoft ( MSFT ) announced its Surface Pro 6 and Surface Laptop 2 portable computers at an event in New York. It also showed off the Surface Studio 2 touch-screen desktop computer and Surface wireless headphones.
On Oct. 9 , Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google trotted out its latest smartphones, the Pixel 3 and Pixel 3XL, at an event in New York. It also took the wraps off a new tablet computer and a smart home hub equipped with a video screen, CNET reported .
